summary: Iteration 9.2 fully verified. Backend pytest test_marina_iteration92.py: 19/19 PASSING. Frontend: all 5 new features working. (1) Products with category: POST /api/products persists category (Bebidas/Sorvetes/Açaí/Outros); invalid category ('Pizza') is coerced to 'Outros'; PUT /api/products/{id} updates category (invalid update also coerces to Outros); GET /api/products returns category AND image_url keys for all products (legacy backfill in seed_users startup is working). (2) Image upload: POST /api/products/{id}/image with multipart PNG returned image_url '/api/files/marina-pararanga/uploads/products/<uuid>.png'; GET on that URL returned 200 with image/png content-type and non-empty body. (3) Check-in: PATCH /api/authorizations/{id}/checkin sets entered_at ISO timestamp; POST/GET /api/authorizations include entered_at (null on create, set after checkin); 404 on unknown id. (4) Regression: login (client/admin/staff), /requests full lifecycle, /convenience/orders (create/list/status), out-of-stock returns 400 'Sem estoque: <name>', emergencies create/list/resolve — all OK. Frontend: (a) /admin-produtos chips produto-cat-Bebidas/Sorvetes/Açaí/Outros all visible + selectable; adding product with Sorvetes creates card that shows category tag with ice-cream icon; 9 produto-image-{id} buttons rendered; tapping the picker button in web preview does not crash (no red screen). (b) /admin-solicitacoes aba Conveniência: caixa-summary card at top with caixa-hoje=R$ 56,00 and caixa-semana=R$ 56,00 (values sum correctly from non-cancelled orders). (c) Autorizações tab: auth-scope-hoje visible; created a live auth via API, auth-checkin-{id} button appeared, tapping it updates card to 'Entrou às 22:03' with log-in icon. (d) /staff loads without red screen or console pageerrors (banner absent because there are 0 open emergencies right now — expected). (e) /conveniencia: renders 4 category groups (Bebidas, Sorvetes, Açaí, Outros) each with its color-coded icon header; 8 in-stock steppers work; conveniencia-total updates (R$ 0,00 → R$ 8,00 after +1 Cerveja); no nostock item currently in DB (all in_stock=true) so we couldn't visually confirm 'Sem estoque' during this run, but backend test test_convenience_out_of_stock_returns_400 explicitly toggled a product and confirmed the flow. Deprecated packages detected: none new (expo-image-picker & expo-audio are current). No SafeAreaView / RN issues detected in the modified files.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:672-688 create_product coerces invalid categories to 'Outros' at write time — safer than validating at read time; matches the spec.
server.py:691-705 update_product also coerces invalid category updates to 'Outros'; behaviour is consistent with create.

server.py:708-728 upload_product_image reads file, uploads to Emergent Object Storage via run_in_threadpool (blocking requests lib is fine), and persists image_url + storage_path atomically; 502 on storage failure is appropriate.
server.py:731-738 serve_file uses run_in_threadpool + long Cache-Control (86400s); good for image reuse.
server.py:854-862 checkin_authorization uses matched_count for 404 detection — correct even if entered_at is idempotently overwritten on multiple taps.

admin-solicitacoes.tsx:97-105 caixa totals filter out 'cancelada' orders and use ISO prefix / Date compare — correct, no timezone bug because both server-issued created_at and local todayISO share the same day boundary check as strings.
admin-solicitacoes.tsx:44-53 useAudioPlayer + Vibration + Haptics wrapped in try/catch — safe on web preview where audio may silently fail.
admin-solicitacoes.tsx:122-127 checkinAuth applies optimistic update and rollback via load() — consistent pattern.
conveniencia.tsx:141-192 grouping by PRODUCT_CATEGORIES.filter keeps a stable ordering (Bebidas → Sorvetes → Açaí → Outros) and hides empty groups — good UX.
admin-produtos.tsx:74-114 pickImage handles permission denial gracefully with 'Abrir Ajustes' fallback; upload uses FormData with Blob branch for web preview (verified image_url returns properly).
api.ts:107-123 uploadProductImage builds a real Blob on web (via fetch(uri).blob()) — this is needed because RN FormData shape does not work in the web bundle; correct handling.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (produto-cat chips, image upload button, caixa summary, auth check-in with 'Entrou às', staff loads clean, client conveniência categorized with steppers)
